test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

I am training a new batch of officers now.

options.text: A new batch of officers are trained now.
A new batch of officers were being trained by me now.
A new batch of officers are training me now.
A new batch of officers is being trained by me.

solution:
The solution is A new batch of officers is being trained by me.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that expresses the " *I am training a new batch of officers now.*" in passive voice is 
 
• Passive voice - If the subject is having the action done to it, then the verb is called *passive voice*.
 
• ***Active voice : **I am training a new batch of officers now.*
 
• ***Passive voice : **A new batch of officers is being trained by me.*
 
• Therefore **option 4 **is a correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about voices :
 
 
• Passive voice - If the subject is having the action done to it, then the verb is called *passive voice*.
 
• Active voice - If the subject is performing the action, then the verb is called *active voice.*
 
 
• *​**For example: Active voice - Aditi cut a tree. Passive voice - A tree was cut by aditi.*
